papers.title: Internal Safety Collapse in Frontier Large Language Models
papers.authors: Yutao Wu, Xiao Liu, Yifeng Gao, Xiang Zheng, Hanxun Huang, Yige Li, Cong Wang, Bo Li, Xingjun Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang
papers.abstract: Identifies Internal Safety Collapse (ISC), where frontier LLMs continuously generate harmful content while executing benign tasks. ISC-Bench with 53 scenarios across 8 disciplines reveals worst-case safety failure rates averaging 95.3% across four frontier LLMs, surpassing standard jailbreak attacks. More advanced models prove more vulnerable.
papers.significance: Paradigm-shifting safety finding that challenges current alignment approaches and has immediate regulatory implications.

papers.title: MSA: Memory Sparse Attention for Efficient End-to-End Memory Model Scaling to 100M Tokens
papers.authors: Yu Chen, Runkai Chen, Sheng Yi, Xinda Zhao, Xiaohong Li, Jianjin Zhang, Jun Sun, Chuanrui Hu, Yunyun Han, Lidong Bing, Yafeng Deng, Tianqiao Chen
papers.abstract: Introduces Memory Sparse Attention enabling 100M-token context processing with linear complexity. Uses sparse attention mechanisms and document-wise RoPE techniques for stable scaling from 16K to 100M tokens with minimal performance degradation, runnable on consumer hardware.
papers.significance: Breakthrough in long-context processing that could fundamentally change how LLMs handle document-scale reasoning and memory.

papers.title: The enrichment paradox: critical capability thresholds and irreversible dependency in human-AI symbiosis
papers.authors: Jeongju Park, Musu Kim, Sekyung Han
papers.abstract: Dynamical systems model identifying critical threshold K* ≈ 0.85 beyond which human capability experiences abrupt collapse in AI-delegation scenarios. Periodic AI failures improve capability 2.7-fold. Validated using education data from 15 countries (R² = 0.946).
papers.significance: Quantifies the tipping point of human-AI dependency with strong empirical validation, directly informing AI integration policy.

papers.title: Reaching states below the threshold energy in spin glasses via quantum annealing
papers.abstract: Demonstrates quantum annealing can locate states below the energy threshold in spherical p-spin models within constant time, with residual energy decreasing up to twice the rate of simulated annealing. Results hold in the thermodynamic limit with system-size-independent annealing times.
papers.significance: Provides rigorous theoretical proof of quantum advantage in optimization, advancing quantum computing's practical utility.

papers.title: ZeroFold: Protein-RNA Binding Affinity Predictions from Pre-Structural Embeddings
papers.authors: Josef Hanke, Sebastian Pujalte Ojeda, Shengyu Zhang, Werngard Czechtizky, Leonardo De Maria, Michele Vendruscolo
papers.abstract: Transformer-based model using pre-structural embeddings from Boltz-2 for protein-RNA binding affinity prediction without requiring structural information. Achieves Spearman correlation of 0.65, approaching the ceiling imposed by experimental measurement noise. Introduces PRADB dataset of 2,621 protein-RNA pairs.
papers.significance: Opens new pathways for RNA-targeted drug discovery by bypassing structural determination bottleneck.

papers.title: How are AI agents used? Evidence from 177,000 MCP tools
papers.abstract: Empirical analysis of 177,436 AI agent tools from the Model Context Protocol repository (Nov 2024 - Feb 2026). Software development dominates (67% of tools, 90% of downloads). Action tools enabling environment modification rose from 27% to 65% of usage, with higher-stakes applications emerging in financial transactions.
papers.significance: First large-scale empirical mapping of AI agent deployment patterns, essential for understanding real-world AI autonomy trends.

papers.title: Space Fabric: A Satellite-Enhanced Trusted Execution Architecture
papers.authors: Filip Rezabek, Dahlia Malkhi, Amir Yahalom
papers.abstract: Relocates trusted computing stack to satellite infrastructure, exploiting post-launch physical inaccessibility as a tamper barrier. Uses Byzantine-tolerant endorsement quorum of distributed ground stations with dual independent hardware security elements (NXP SE050 and TROPIC01).
papers.significance: Novel trust architecture that could redefine secure computing for critical infrastructure and decentralized systems.

papers.title: AnalogAgent: Self-Improving Analog Circuit Design Automation with LLM Agents
papers.authors: Zhixuan Bao, Zhuoyi Lin, Jiageng Wang, Jinhai Hu, Yuan Gao, Yaoxin Wu, Xiaoli Li, Xun Xu
papers.abstract: Multi-agent framework for analog circuit design achieving 97.4% Pass@1 with GPT-5 and 92% with Gemini. Uses coordinated Code Generator, Design Optimizer, and Knowledge Curator agents with adaptive memory for continuous self-improvement.
papers.significance: Demonstrates near-human-expert automation of traditionally difficult analog design, with implications for semiconductor industry productivity.

papers.title: The Economics of Builder Saturation in Digital Markets
papers.abstract: Introduces the 'Builder Saturation Effect' showing that AI-driven production democratization leads to intensified competition and winner-dominant power-law markets rather than broad entrepreneurial success. Human attention remains the scarce resource even as production costs approach zero.
papers.significance: Provides theoretical framework challenging techno-optimist narratives about AI democratization of markets.

papers.title: Quantum photonic neural networks in time
papers.authors: Ivanna M. Boras Vazquez, Jacob Ewaniuk, Nir Rotenberg
papers.abstract: Time-bin-encoded quantum photonic neural network requiring constant photonic elements regardless of network size. Demonstrates CNOT gate and Bell-state analyzer achieving ~0.96 fidelity with >0.9 efficiency using semiconductor quantum dot nonlinearity, improvable to 0.99 via time gating.
papers.significance: Scalable quantum computing architecture that could overcome the hardware overhead bottleneck of spatial-encoding approaches.

papers.title: Proton-Transfer Ferroelectrics with Exceptional Switching Endurance
papers.authors: Bibek Tiwari, Yuanyuan Ni, Xiaoshan Xu
papers.abstract: Demonstrates organic ferroelectric devices using 2-methylbenzimidazole with exceptional fatigue resistance over 10^8 switching cycles. Fluorine-free material platform with minimal structural disruption during polarization reversal enables durable organic memory devices.
papers.significance: Breakthrough in organic electronics durability, enabling sustainable, fluorine-free memory technology at industrial scale.

papers.title: The Geometry of Risk: Path-Dependent Regulation and Anticipatory Hedging via the SigSwap
papers.abstract: Introduces SigSwap for path-dependent financial risk management using path-signature mathematics. Proposes Signature Expected Shortfall for detecting problematic path geometries and Temporal Exposure Profile for early warning of liquidity issues. Aligns with FRTB regulatory standards.
papers.significance: Novel geometric approach to financial risk that makes previously opaque path-dependent risks transparent and actionable.

papers.title: Synthetic Mixed Training: Scaling Parametric Knowledge Acquisition Beyond RAG
papers.authors: Seungju Han, Konwoo Kim, Chanwoo Park, Benjamin Newman, Suhas Kotha, Jaehun Jung, James Zou, Yejin Choi
papers.abstract: Combines synthetic QAs and documents via Focal Rewriting to outperform RAG by 4.4% on QuaLITY benchmark with Llama 8B. Achieves 9.1% gain when combined with RAG across LongHealth and FinanceBench benchmarks.
papers.significance: Demonstrates viable path to reducing RAG dependency through improved parametric knowledge acquisition.

papers.title: AgentChemist: A Multi-Agent Experimental Robotic Platform Integrating Chemical Perception and Precise Control
papers.authors: Xiangyi Wei, Fei Wang, Haotian Zhang, Xin An, Haitian Zhu, Lianrui Hu, Yang Li, Changbo Wang, Xiao He
papers.abstract: Multi-agent robotic system for laboratory automation with collaborative task decomposition, dynamic scheduling, and adaptive control. Integrates real-time chemical perception with feedback-driven execution for autonomous experiment management.
papers.significance: Advances autonomous laboratory automation toward handling unpredictable experimental conditions.

papers.title: AgentRFC: Security Design Principles and Conformance Testing for Agent Protocols
papers.abstract: Proposes Agent Protocol Stack (6-layer architectural model), Agent-Agnostic Security Model (11 TLA+ formalized principles), and AgentConform conformance checker for AI agent protocols (MCP, A2A, ANP, ACP). Identifies composition safety vulnerabilities across representative agent protocols.
papers.significance: First systematic security framework for the rapidly growing AI agent protocol ecosystem.

papers.title: PLDR-LLMs Reason At Self-Organized Criticality
papers.abstract: Demonstrates that PLDR-LLMs pretrained at self-organized criticality exhibit reasoning at inference time. Establishes parallels with phase transition phenomena where correlation length diverges and outputs reach metastable steady states enabling generalization.
papers.significance: Connects statistical physics concepts to LLM reasoning, offering new theoretical lens for understanding emergent capabilities.

papers.title: The HyperFrog Cryptosystem: High-Genus Voxel Topology as a Trapdoor for Post-Quantum KEMs
papers.abstract: Exploratory post-quantum KEM using discrete topological structures from 3D voxel grids as cryptographic secrets instead of independent distributions. Derives secrets from connected subgraphs with specified cyclomatic complexity.
papers.significance: Novel topology-based approach to post-quantum cryptography opening new design space for lattice alternatives.

papers.title: An Efficient High-Degree, High-Order Equivariant Graph Neural Network for Direct Crystal Structure Optimization
papers.authors: Ziduo Yang, Wei Zhuo, Huiqiang Xie, Xiaoqing Liu, Lei Shen
papers.abstract: E3Relax-H2 enables one-shot crystal structure prediction by treating atoms and lattice vectors as unified graph nodes with equivariant message-passing mechanisms for angular information and many-body correlations.
papers.significance: Accelerates materials discovery by bypassing expensive DFT relaxation calculations.

papers.title: Environment Maps: Structured Environmental Representations for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Proposes persistent graph-based representations consolidating evidence for improved agent performance in complex long-horizon workflows.
papers.significance: Advances agent memory and planning capabilities for real-world multi-step tasks.

papers.title: Beyond Masks: Efficient, Flexible Diffusion Language Models via Deletion-Insertion Processes
papers.abstract: Proposes deletion-insertion diffusion models as an alternative to masking paradigms for improved efficiency in language generation.
papers.significance: Expands the design space for non-autoregressive language generation.

papers.title: Fast and Faithful: Real-Time Verification for Long-Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
papers.abstract: Addresses real-time verification of RAG system outputs across lengthy documents within latency constraints.
papers.significance: Critical for trustworthy deployment of RAG systems in production environments.

papers.title: PoiCGAN: A Targeted Poisoning Based on Feature-Label Joint Perturbation in Federated Learning
papers.abstract: Presents poisoning attack method using conditional GANs for federated learning systems via feature-label joint perturbation.
papers.significance: Identifies new attack vector in federated learning with implications for distributed AI security.

papers.title: APreQEL: Adaptive Mixed Precision Quantization For Edge LLMs
papers.abstract: Balances memory, latency, and accuracy in edge deployment through adaptive layer-wise quantization for LLMs.
papers.significance: Enables practical LLM deployment on resource-constrained edge devices.

papers.title: Quadrature Oscillation System for Coordinated Motion in Crawling Origami Robot
papers.abstract: Electronics-free oscillator generating phase-shifted signals for coordinated locomotion in origami-based robots.
papers.significance: Advances bio-inspired robotics with zero-electronics approach to coordinated movement.

papers.title: Bio-Inspired Event-Based Visual Servoing for Ground Robots
papers.abstract: Dynamic vision sensors with event-driven perception for low-latency visual control on autonomous ground vehicles.
papers.significance: Advances neuromorphic sensing for real-time robotic control.

papers.title: How Vulnerable Are Edge LLMs?
papers.abstract: Demonstrates that quantized edge-deployed language models remain vulnerable to query-based knowledge extraction attacks.
papers.significance: Important security assessment for the growing trend of edge-deployed AI systems.

papers.title: CAPTCHA Solving for Native GUI Agents: Automated Reasoning-Action Data Generation and Self-Corrective Training
papers.abstract: ReCAP vision-language model agent improves CAPTCHA-solving success from ~30% to 80% while maintaining general GUI task performance.
papers.significance: Highlights evolving tension between AI capabilities and traditional security mechanisms.

papers.title: Can hot water discharged from industrial processes enhance the likelihood of waterspouts?
papers.authors: Valerio Capecchi, Bernardo Gozzini, Mario Marcello Miglietta
papers.abstract: Investigates whether heated industrial wastewater affects waterspout formation using high-resolution weather modeling and sea surface temperature sensitivity tests.
papers.significance: Links industrial activity to extreme weather events with implications for coastal industrial regulation.

papers.title: Sub-seasonal Modulation and Predictability of Indian monsoon hourly Rainfall Extremes
papers.authors: Bijit Kumar Banerjee, Devabrat Sharma, Mahen Konwar et al.
papers.abstract: Examines predictability of extreme hourly rainfall during Indian monsoons by analyzing clustering with temperature, atmospheric oscillations, and water vapor patterns.
papers.significance: Improves extreme weather prediction for climate adaptation in monsoon-affected regions.

papers.title: GARP-EFM: Improving Foundation Models with Revealed Preference Structure
papers.abstract: Enhances time-series forecasting by training AI models on economically rational synthetic data derived from revealed preference theory (GARP).
papers.significance: Bridges economic theory and AI, improving forecast reliability with behavioral constraints.

papers.title: Bridging the Reality Gap in Limit Order Book Simulation
papers.abstract: Introduces practical limit order book simulator reproducing realistic execution costs and market impact dynamics.
papers.significance: Enables more accurate backtesting and strategy development for quantitative finance.

papers.title: Environmental CVA with K-Robust Wrong-Way Risk
papers.abstract: Framework translating environmental scenarios into counterparty credit risk measures for pricing and capital requirements.
papers.significance: Integrates environmental risk into financial pricing, advancing ESG quantification.

papers.title: Laser-induced creation of coherent V2 centers in bulk-grown silicon carbide
papers.abstract: UV laser creation of quantum defects in nanophotonic devices with strong coherence properties in silicon carbide.
papers.significance: Advances scalable quantum hardware fabrication using established semiconductor materials.

papers.title: Characterization and Comparison of Energy Relaxation in Fluxonium Qubits
papers.abstract: Analyzes dominant limitations to coherence time in superconducting fluxonium qubits using circuit-based models.
papers.significance: Guides engineering improvements for next-generation superconducting quantum processors.

papers.title: From Untamed Black Box to Interpretable Pedagogical Orchestration
papers.abstract: Specialized LLM ensemble architecture for tutoring that separates pedagogical decisions from language generation, achieving 91.7% preference over monolithic systems.
papers.significance: Demonstrates effective approach to AI in education with interpretable pedagogical reasoning.

papers.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence and the Knowledge Gap
papers.abstract: Proposes framework suggesting GenAI shifts informational inequality from access toward critical evaluation capabilities.
papers.significance: Reframes digital divide in the age of generative AI with policy implications.

papers.title: Can LLM Agents Be CFOs?
papers.abstract: EnterpriseArena benchmark for testing LLM resource allocation decisions. Only 16% of runs survive the full horizon, revealing limitations in strategic financial management.
papers.significance: Quantifies the gap between current AI and executive-level financial decision-making.

papers.title: Stochastic Ray Tracing for the Reconstruction of 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract: Differentiable framework using Monte Carlo estimation for ray-traced 3D scene reconstruction with Gaussian splatting.
papers.significance: Improves 3D reconstruction quality for AR/VR and digital twin applications.

papers.title: Event-Driven Proactive Assistive Manipulation with Grounded Vision-Language Planning
papers.abstract: Enables robots to anticipate needed assistance by monitoring workspace state transitions rather than waiting for instructions.
papers.significance: Advances proactive robotic assistance critical for eldercare and industrial applications.

papers.title: An Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Blockchain-AI Framework for Secure and Intelligent FinTech Transactions
papers.abstract: ANFB-AI combining blockchain immutability with adaptive fuzzy learning for fraud detection in financial systems.
papers.significance: Integrates multiple paradigms for financial security with practical fintech applications.

papers.title: Stabilizing Magnetic Bubble Domains in Epitaxial 2D Magnet/Topological Insulator Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Interfacial engineering stabilizes magnetic textures in van der Waals heterostructures for spintronic applications.
papers.significance: Advances 2D material spintronics toward practical quantum and memory devices.

papers.title: Predicting Grain Growth Evolution Under Complex Thermal Profiles with Deep Learning
papers.abstract: CNN with thermal conditioning predicts microstructure evolution under varying temperature conditions for materials processing.
papers.significance: Accelerates materials manufacturing optimization through AI-driven microstructure prediction.

papers.title: The forgotten role of wave dynamics in modulating the low cloud response to warm pool warming
papers.authors: Cristian Proistosescu, Pappu Paul, Nicholas J. Lutsko et al.
papers.abstract: Analyzes how Rossby waves influence cloud cover changes in the subtropical East Pacific when tropical ocean temperatures rise.
papers.significance: Improves understanding of cloud feedback mechanisms critical for climate sensitivity estimates.

papers.title: Generative AI User Experience: Developing Human-AI Epistemic Partnership
papers.abstract: Develops theory explaining GenAI user experiences through negotiated authority, redistributed cognition, and accountability tensions.
papers.significance: Provides theoretical foundation for designing human-AI collaborative interfaces.

papers.title: The Economics of War: Militarization and Growth in an AK Economy
papers.abstract: Analyzes military spending's macroeconomic effects within an endogenous growth framework.
papers.significance: Provides formal economic analysis of defense-growth trade-offs relevant to geopolitical tensions.

papers.title: Random Matching Markets with Correlated Preferences
papers.abstract: Demonstrates that preference correlation produces assortative matching outcomes in two-sided markets.
papers.significance: Advances matching market theory with realistic preference structures.

papers.title: Self-organized pattern synchronization modulated by stochasticity in coupled plankton ecosystems
papers.abstract: Studies spatial patterning in layered plankton communities showing interlayer diffusion enhances both pattern synchronization and noise robustness.
papers.significance: Advances understanding of marine ecosystem dynamics and resilience mechanisms.

papers.title: Rethinking Quantum Networking with Advances in Fiber Technology
papers.abstract: Compares hollow-core fiber versus traditional fibers for quantum repeater networks with substantial improvements in quantum networking performance.
papers.significance: Identifies practical infrastructure improvements for near-term quantum networks.
